paper.title: Self-Correcting Code Agents via Execution-Grounded Reinforcement Learning
paper.summary: Large language model agents that write code still struggle to recover from their own mistakes. We introduce EGRL, an execution-grounded reinforcement learning recipe that trains agents on their own repair traces.

title: Self-Correcting Code Agents via Execution-Grounded Reinforcement Learning

paper.title: Benchmarking Text-to-Video Consistency with Story-Level Evaluation
paper.summary: We present StoryEval, a benchmark measuring temporal and character consistency in minute-long generated videos across 12 leading models.

title: Benchmarking Text-to-Video Consistency with Story-Level Evaluation
